description: Queries the complete 579 alchemical recipe database to discover cosmic, cosmos-aligned dishes matching specific keyword prompts, cuisines, elements, and dietary restrictions. Costs 7.5 of each ESMS token when called with an authenticated _meta.apiKey. Optional `_meta.apiKey` (your alchm.kitchen API key) and `_meta.caller` (your client identifier, e.g. 'claude-desktop') unlock per-user quotas and invocation telemetry.
